headline: Kohinoor submits integrated corporate governance filing
summary: Kohinoor has submitted its integrated corporate governance filing to the National Stock Exchange. This is a routine regulatory disclosure required of listed entities. Indian retail investors should note this is standard compliance procedural data with no immediate financial impact on share price.
why_it_matters: Standard compliance update with no financial impact.

headline: Kohinoor Foods announces AGM voting results
hook: AGM voting results filed by Kohinoor Foods
summary: Kohinoor Foods Limited has submitted the voting results of its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2025, to the exchange. This is a routine compliance filing required for listed entities following shareholder meetings. Shareholders and retail investors can review the outcome of resolutions passed at the AGM. The disclosure has a negligible impact on day-to-day trading for retail investors.
why_it_matters: Routine corporate compliance with no immediate impact on stock price.
